title: Peak Demand Capacity Playbook
content_text: When forecast or observed workload exceeds safely available capacity, first validate AHT, call routing, schedule adherence, not-ready codes, and intraday staffing availability. Evaluate queue-level and donor-queue risks before approving any temporary staffing transfer. Human manager approval is required for operational changes.

title: Escalation and Notification Matrix
content_text: Watch incidents route to the real-time team. High-impact incidents also notify an operations manager. Critical incidents notify the designated director. Suppress repeated identical notifications within the configured cooldown, but never suppress a new severity escalation or a first notification to a newly required role.

title: SLA Calculation Standards
content_text: Interval SLA is answered contacts within service-level threshold divided by answered contacts. Abandon rate is abandoned contacts divided by offered contacts. AHT is weighted by answered contacts during aggregation; daily and monthly SLAs are calculated from numerators and denominators, never averaged from interval percentages.

title: Human Approval and Audit Policy
content_text: Recommendations are advisory. Only an authorized designated role can approve consequential actions. Every action must retain incident ID, approver, permission level, timestamp, status transitions, supporting evidence, planned outcome, and observed outcome. Simulated approvals must never be represented as real enterprise actions.

title: Knowledge Drift and Version Control
content_text: When current documents disagree, cite both versions with dates, flag the conflict, and seek confirmation from a designated policy owner. Do not silently treat the most recent document as authorized unless approval status confirms it.

title: Planned Marketing Campaign Advisory
content_text: A planned campaign is scheduled for Queue A on August 15 from 14:00 through 19:00 local time. An additional staffing allocation of 17 agents was anticipated. Treat an elevated workload within the approved campaign window as expected if within forecast, but continue monitoring downstream effects and atypical deviations.

title: Decision Sandbox Safety Guidance
content_text: Always show a no-action comparator. Projected metrics must come from a reproducible simulation method, with assumptions and constraints. Check donor queue service levels before recommending reallocation. Never present heuristic projections as calibrated probability or production-grade Erlang-C forecasting.
